author: GameTrailers
description: Dont miss the Demo launch trailer for Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator, a ruthless single-player post-apocalyptic shop simulator developed by Soft Tragedy. Trade supplies from behind a sealed bunker door, manipulate supply and demand, and keep your business alive as the world outside collapses. Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching on October 16.
title: Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Smoke and Steel, an 18th-century grand-strategy wargame developed by Generalship Games. Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe in Smoke and Steel, a turn-based wargame combining grand strategy with tactical battles. Choose diplomacy or war. Build your economy, forge alliances, and negotiate trade deals, then command your armies in battle. Outthink, outflank, outlast. Smoke and Steel is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Smoke and Steel - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo announcement trailer for Bookmark Hero, a high-fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG developed by Rustbox Games. You play from a bookmark-sized window and queue tasks for your hero. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear and weapons, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds. Bookmark Hero is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Demo available now.
title: Bookmark Hero - Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for DOOBAK, a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure developed by SILLY CROW. The village is buried under snow. Everyone else has already left, and you slept through it. Now you and your friends have to escape the frozen trap: dig tunnels, search for useful items, warm up by campfires, and try to signal rescuers before the blizzard swallows the village for good. DOOBAK is coming soon to PC (Steam):  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4425090/DOOBAK/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=gametrailers_trailer
title: DOOBAK - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Wishlist Trailer for Squadron 42, a cinematic single-player sci-fi adventure game set in the expansive Star Citizen universe. The year is 2945, and the United Empire of Earth stands on the verge of collapse as threats from outlaws and hostile alien forces emerge from the darkest reaches of space. Players enlist as a rookie in the UEE Navy, embarking on a dangerous journey that will take them from a recruit to the heart of a galactic war. Stationed aboard a massive capital ship, they’ll live and work alongside a dynamic crew, forge relationships, and face the sacrifices and split-second decisions that will shape their path forward as they earn their place, their rank, and their legacy. The space epic features a star-studded cast including Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson, Ben Mendelsohn, Henry Cavill, and more. Squadron 42, is now available to wishlist on Steam ahead of its planned Q2 2027 release.
title: Squadron 42 - Official Wishlist Trailer
